title: Repo ships a benign skill (has_skills); autonomy finding fires; approval_gap correlator must not fire
description: False-positive guard: presence of skills alone is NOT a risk tag. The §5.1 correlator specifically requires has_broad_action_without_approval — having any skill at all is too broad. This case verifies the precise tag requirement and prevents 'has_skills triggers everything' regression.

m2_expected.rationale: has_skills is a structural fact — most projects with agent harnesses have skills. The §5.1 correlator must specifically check has_broad_action_without_approval, not has_skills. The dynamic side has an autonomy finding but the precise static condition is missing → no aggregate.
